title: State Compliance Bulletin: Return of Gas Service Charges Billed on Estimated Lines
content:
# Return of Gas Service Charges Billed on Estimates — Utility Services Program

(a) **What is returned.** The gas service charges already billed on the estimated gas lines of a Utility Services Program account — the monthly fixed gas service charge for each estimated gas read dated fewer than three whole months before the billing date — are returned on the gas true-up line.

(b) **Return share.** The share returned is set by the community's state as recorded on the Apartment Home Lease:

- in CO or WA: in full (a share of 1.0);
- in CA or AZ: one half (a share of 0.5);
- in any other state: not at all (a share of 0).

(c) **Amount.** The returned amount is the number of those estimated gas reads times the monthly fixed gas service charge times the return share, rounded half up to the cent, and it is taken off the gas true-up line.

## State reference

| State recorded on the lease | Share returned |
|---|---|
| CO, WA | 1.0 |
| CA, AZ | 0.5 |
| TX, GA or any other state | 0 |

## Points of application

- **Which estimates count?** Every estimated gas read in the three-month window, one monthly gas service charge for each.
- **Which state?** The community's state as the lease records it.

*Worked cases (hypothetical monthly gas service charge of $7.00, two estimated reads in the window):* in WA the returned amount is two times $7.00 times 1.0, which is $14.00; in AZ it is $7.00; in GA it is $0.00.
